===
Empty module
===
module M {}
---
(Root
  Nodes: (Module Tok: "module"
    Name: (Ident "M")))

===
Module with language clause
===
module M language "TTCN-3:2018" {}
---
(Root
  Nodes: (Module Tok: "module"
    Name: (Ident "M")
    Language: (LanguageSpec Tok: "language" List: "\"TTCN-3:2018\"")))

===
Module with multiple language clauses
===
module M language "TTCN-3:2018", "TTCN-3:2012" {}
---
(Root
  Nodes: (Module Tok: "module"
    Name: (Ident "M")
    Language: (LanguageSpec Tok: "language" List: "\"TTCN-3:2018\"" List: "\"TTCN-3:2012\"")))

===
Multiple modules
===
module A {}
module B {}
---
(Root
  Nodes: (Module Tok: "module"
    Name: (Ident "A"))
  Nodes: (Module Tok: "module"
    Name: (Ident "B")))

===
Import all
===
module M {
  import from A all;
}
---

  Nodes: (Module Tok: "module"
    Name: (Ident "M")
    Defs: (ModuleDef
      Def: (ImportDecl ImportTok: "import" FromTok: "from"
        Module: (Ident "A")
        List: (DefKindExpr
          List: (Ident "all"))))))

===
Import all except
===

  import from A all except { type T; function f; };
}
---
(Root
  Nodes: (Module Tok: "module"
    Name: (Ident "M")
    Defs: (ModuleDef
      Def: (ImportDecl ImportTok: "import" FromTok: "from"
        Module: (Ident "A")
        List: (DefKindExpr
          List: (ExceptExpr ExceptTok: "except"
            X: (Ident "all")
            List: (DefKindExpr KindTok: "type"
              List: (Ident "T"))
            List: (DefKindExpr KindTok: "function"
              List: (Ident "f"))))))))

===

          List: (Ident "t2"))))))

===
Import of every kind
===
module M {
  import from A {
    group g;
    type T;
    template t;
    const c;
    testcase tc;
    altstep as;
    function f;
    signature s;
    modulepar mp;
    import all;
  }
}
---
(Root
  Nodes: (Module Tok: "module"
    Name: (Ident "M")
    Defs: (ModuleDef
      Def: (ImportDecl ImportTok: "import" FromTok: "from"
        Module: (Ident "A")
        List: (DefKindExpr KindTok: "group"
          List: (Ident "g"))
        List: (DefKindExpr KindTok: "type"
          List: (Ident "T"))
        List: (DefKindExpr KindTok: "template"
          List: (Ident "t"))
        List: (DefKindExpr KindTok: "const"
          List: (Ident "c"))
        List: (DefKindExpr KindTok: "testcase"
          List: (Ident "tc"))
        List: (DefKindExpr KindTok: "altstep"
          List: (Ident "as"))
        List: (DefKindExpr KindTok: "function"
          List: (Ident "f"))
        List: (DefKindExpr KindTok: "signature"
          List: (Ident "s"))
        List: (DefKindExpr KindTok: "modulepar"
          List: (Ident "mp"))
        List: (DefKindExpr KindTok: "import"
          List: (Ident "all"))))))

===
Nested groups
===

  group outer {
    group inner {
      type integer I;
    }
    const integer c := 1;
  }
}

  Nodes: (Module Tok: "module"
    Name: (Ident "M")
    Defs: (ModuleDef
      Def: (GroupDecl Tok: "group"
        Name: (Ident "outer")
        Defs: (ModuleDef
          Def: (GroupDecl Tok: "group"
            Name: (Ident "inner")
            Defs: (ModuleDef
              Def: (SubTypeDecl TypeTok: "type"
                Field: (Field
                  Type: (RefSpec
                    X: (Ident "integer"))
                  Name: (Ident "I"))))))
        Defs: (ModuleDef
          Def: (ValueDecl KindTok: "const"
            Type: (Ident "integer")
            Decls: (Declarator AssignTok: ":="
              Name: (Ident "c")
              Value: (ValueLiteral "1"))))))))

  type integer I;
  const I c := 1;
  template I t := 1;
  function f() {}
  altstep a() {}
  testcase tc() {}
  signature s();

  control {}

          Name: (Ident "I"))))
    Defs: (ModuleDef
      Def: (ValueDecl KindTok: "const"
        Type: (Ident "I")
        Decls: (Declarator AssignTok: ":="
          Name: (Ident "c")
          Value: (ValueLiteral "1"))))
    Defs: (ModuleDef
      Def: (TemplateDecl TemplateTok: "template" AssignTok: ":="
        Type: (Ident "I")
        Name: (Ident "t")
        Value: (ValueLiteral "1")))

      Def: (FuncDecl KindTok: "function"
        Name: (Ident "f")
        Params: (FormalPars)
        Body: (BlockStmt)))
    Defs: (ModuleDef
      Def: (FuncDecl KindTok: "altstep"
        Name: (Ident "a")
        Params: (FormalPars)
        Body: (BlockStmt)))

      Def: (FuncDecl KindTok: "testcase"
        Name: (Ident "tc")
        Params: (FormalPars)

===
Real-world: Module header with imports and parameters
===
module Example language "TTCN-3:2018" {
  import from Types all;
  import from Templates { template all; type all; };
  friend module Other;
  modulepar {
    integer PX_Timeout := 5;
    charstring PX_Host := "localhost";
  }
  group Constants {
    const integer c_max := 10;
    const float c_pi := 3.14;
  }
} with {
  encode "RAW";
  variant "FIELDORDER(msb)"
}
---
(Root
  Nodes: (Module Tok: "module"
    Name: (Ident "Example")
    Language: (LanguageSpec Tok: "language" List: "\"TTCN-3:2018\"")
    Defs: (ModuleDef
      Def: (ImportDecl ImportTok: "import" FromTok: "from"
        Module: (Ident "Types")
        List: (DefKindExpr
          List: (Ident "all"))))
    Defs: (ModuleDef
      Def: (ImportDecl ImportTok: "import" FromTok: "from"
        Module: (Ident "Templates")
        List: (DefKindExpr KindTok: "template"
          List: (Ident "all"))
        List: (DefKindExpr KindTok: "type"
          List: (Ident "all"))))
    Defs: (ModuleDef
      Def: (FriendDecl FriendTok: "friend" ModuleTok: "module"
        Modules: (Ident "Other")))
    Defs: (ModuleDef
      Def: (ModuleParameterGroup Tok: "modulepar"
        Decls: (ValueDecl

===
Real-world: Test suite control part
===
module Suite {
  import from Cases all;
  control {
    execute(TC_001(), 5.0);
    execute(TC_002());
    if (PX_Run) {
      execute(TC_003());
    }
  }
}
---
(Root
  Nodes: (Module Tok: "module"
    Name: (Ident "Suite")
    Defs: (ModuleDef
      Def: (ImportDecl ImportTok: "import" FromTok: "from"
        Module: (Ident "Cases")
        List: (DefKindExpr
          List: (Ident "all"))))
    Defs: (ModuleDef
      Def: (ControlPart
        Name: (Ident "control")
        Body: (BlockStmt
          Stmts: (ExprStmt
            Expr: (CallExpr
              Fun: (Ident "execute")
              Args: (ParenExpr
                List: (CallExpr
                  Fun: (Ident "TC_001")
                  Args: (ParenExpr))
                List: (ValueLiteral "5.0"))))
          Stmts: (ExprStmt
            Expr: (CallExpr
              Fun: (Ident "execute")
              Args: (ParenExpr
                List: (CallExpr
                  Fun: (Ident "TC_002")
                  Args: (ParenExpr)))))
          Stmts: (IfStmt Tok: "if"
            Cond: (Ident "PX_Run")
            Then: (BlockStmt
              Stmts: (ExprStmt
                Expr: (CallExpr
                  Fun: (Ident "execute")
                  Args: (ParenExpr
                    List: (CallExpr
                      Fun: (Ident "TC_003")
                      Args: (ParenExpr))))))))))))

===
Definitions without semicolons
===
module M {
  const integer a := 1
  const integer b := 2
}
---
(Root
  Nodes: (Module Tok: "module"
    Name: (Ident "M")
    Defs: (ModuleDef
      Def: (ValueDecl KindTok: "const"
        Type: (Ident "integer")
        Decls: (Declarator AssignTok: ":="
          Name: (Ident "a")
          Value: (ValueLiteral "1"))))
    Defs: (ModuleDef
      Def: (ValueDecl KindTok: "const"
        Type: (Ident "integer")
        Decls: (Declarator AssignTok: ":="
          Name: (Ident "b")
          Value: (ValueLiteral "2"))))))
